statement: Do not have relations with your father's brother's wife
note: C0584 itemizes the uncle's-wife clause of Lev 18:14.

statement: Do not have male relations with your father's brother
note: C0584 holds Lev 18:14 but states only the uncle's wife; the uncle clause is covered only generally by C0592 (Lev 18:22).

statement: Do not have relations with your son's wife
note: C0585 itemizes Lev 18:15.

statement: Do not have relations with your brother's wife
note: C0586 itemizes Lev 18:16 with Lev 20:21, noting the levirate exception.

statement: Do not have relations with a woman and her daughter
note: C0587 states the woman-and-daughter union with both granddaughter cases; C0650 gives the burning penalty.

statement: Do not have relations with a woman and her son's daughter
note: C0587 names the granddaughter combinations of Lev 18:17 in one record.

statement: Do not have relations with a woman and her daughter's daughter
note: The same record C0587 covers the daughter's-daughter combination.

statement: Do not marry your wife's sister during your wife's lifetime
note: C0588 itemizes Lev 18:18; S066 is a topical study.

statement: Do not have relations with a menstruating woman
note: C0589 itemizes Lev 18:19 with Lev 20:18.

statement: Do not have relations with another man's wife
note: Only the Decalogue record C0154 (Mosaic Command) holds Lev 18:20; Lev 18's other unions are Torah Law. C0646 gives only the penalty.

statement: Do not give your children to Molech
note: C0590 itemizes Lev 18:21 (Saints: 'serve a ruler'); C0644 and C0645 add the Lev 20 rules.

statement: Do not have male-male intercourse
note: C0592 itemizes Lev 18:22; C0649 gives the Lev 20:13 penalty.

statement: A man must not have relations with an animal
note: C0593 covers men and women (Lev 18:23, Deut 27:21); C0201 and C0651 give penalties.

statement: A woman must not have relations with an animal
note: C0593's context names the conduct for women as well as men.

statement: Revere your father and mother
note: C0595 itemizes the reverence clause of Lev 19:3.

statement: Do not make an idol, even for others to worship
note: Lev 19:4's cast-gods clause has no own record; only Decalogue C0147 (Command, includes Exod 34:17 molten gods) states it. C0596 covers turning.

statement: Do not turn to idolatry in thought or study
note: C0596 itemizes the turning-to-idols clause of Lev 19:4; C1018 (Deut 12:30) is related.

statement: Do not eat sacrificial meat left beyond its time (notar)
note: C0453 (Lev 7:18) holds Lev 19:7-8 as additional Scripture; C0452 (burning leftovers) is an Instruction.

statement: Leave the corner of the field for the poor
note: C0601 (leave the portions, with Lev 23:22) and C0597 (do not reap completely) itemize the corner law.

statement: Leave the gleanings of the harvest for the poor
note: C0601 states the duty to leave the portions; C0598 forbids collecting the gleanings.

statement: Do not gather the gleanings of the harvest
note: C0598 itemizes Lev 19:9b with Lev 23:22.

statement: Leave the undeveloped grape clusters (olelot) for the poor
note: C0601 covers leaving the vineyard portions; C0599 forbids the second vineyard gleaning.

statement: Leave the fallen grapes (peret) for the poor
note: C0601 covers leaving the portions; C0600 forbids gathering the fallen grapes.

statement: Do not gather the undeveloped grape clusters (olelot)
note: C0599 ('do not strip the vineyard by a second gleaning') matches the olelot clause.

statement: Do not gather the fallen grapes (peret)
note: C0600 itemizes the fallen-grapes clause of Lev 19:10.

statement: Do not steal money or property stealthily
note: Lev 19:11's 'You shall not steal' has no own record; only Decalogue C0155 (Command) states it, which Maimonides reads as kidnapping.

statement: Do not falsely deny holding another's money or deposit
note: Saints renders this clause 'You shall not lie'; C0602 ('Do not lie') itemizes it in general terms.

statement: Do not swear falsely when denying another's monetary claim
note: C0603 itemizes the clause as Saints renders it ('defraud'); the false-oath element is covered by C0604.

statement: Do not swear falsely in God's name
note: C0604 itemizes Lev 19:12.

statement: Do not delay paying a hired worker's wages
note: C0607 itemizes the overnight-wages clause of Lev 19:13; S074 is a topical study.

statement: Do not rob (take property by force)
note: C0606 itemizes the robbery clause of Lev 19:13.

statement: Do not withhold what is owed to your neighbour (oshek)
note: C0605 ('Do not wrong your neighbour') itemizes the oshek clause as Saints renders it.

statement: Do not put a stumbling block before the blind (mislead)
note: C0609 itemizes Lev 19:14b with Deut 27:18.

statement: Do not curse any Israelite, even the deaf
note: C0608 ('Do not curse the deaf') itemizes the clause Maimonides extends to every Israelite.

statement: Judge your neighbour righteously
note: C0612 itemizes the closing clause of Lev 19:15.

statement: A judge must not pervert justice
note: The opening clause 'do no injustice in judgment' has no own record; C0612 states the same duty positively. Deut 16:19 lacks a record too.

statement: A judge must not favour the great or powerful
note: C0611 itemizes this clause; C0958 (Deut 1:17) is a parallel.

statement: A judge must not favour the poor out of pity
note: Lev 19:15's poor clause has no own record; C0219 (Exod 23:3, Torah Law) states the same law.

statement: Do not stand idly by when a life is in danger
note: Saints reads 'conspire against the blood'; C0614 forbids conspiring, not standing by. No record states the duty to rescue.

statement: Do not go about as a talebearer (gossip)
note: C0613 ('go about deceitfully', Saints wording) itemizes the talebearing clause; S076 reads it as slander.

statement: Rebuke a neighbour who does wrong
note: Only C0616 (Mosaic Command) itemizes it, though the same verse's prohibitions are Torah Law; it reads as a standing duty.

statement: Do not hate your brother in your heart
note: C0615 itemizes Lev 19:17a.

statement: Do not shame or embarrass a person when rebuking
note: C0617 holds the clause but reads it as not sharing in the neighbour's sin; no record forbids shaming.

statement: Love your neighbour as yourself
note: C0620 (Mosaic Command) itemizes it; an affirmative charge of love like loving God, so not a mislabel.

statement: Do not take revenge
note: C0618 itemizes Lev 19:18a.

statement: Do not bear a grudge
note: C0619 itemizes the grudge clause of Lev 19:18.

statement: Do not sow mixed seeds together
note: C0622 ('cultivated plot') covers the Saints 'vineyard' wording of Lev 19:19.

statement: Do not crossbreed animals of different kinds
note: C0621 itemizes the livestock clause of Lev 19:19.

statement: Do not eat fruit of a tree's first three years (orlah)
note: C0626 itemizes Lev 19:23 with 19:25.

statement: Treat fourth-year fruit as holy to the Lord
note: C0627 itemizes Lev 19:24.

statement: Do not practise divination by omens (nichush)
note: C0629 matches nichush; if this number is read as soothsaying (onen), C0630 itemizes it. Both are Torah Law.

statement: Do not eat and drink like a glutton (rebellious son)
note: C0628 follows the Saints 'eat on the mountains' reading; no record states the glutton prohibition (C1118-C1119 treat the rebellious-son case).

statement: Do not round off the corners of the head
note: C0631 itemizes the 'sisoe' haircut clause of Lev 19:27.

statement: Do not destroy the corners of the beard
note: C0632 itemizes the beard clause of Lev 19:27.

statement: Do not tattoo the body
note: C0634 itemizes the tattoo clause; C0633 covers the mourning incisions.

statement: Revere the sanctuary
note: Only C0636 (Mosaic Command) itemizes it, while 'revere father and mother' (C0595) is Torah Law; it reads as a standing rule.

statement: Do not practise as a spirit medium (ov)
note: C1074 forbids practising as a medium (Deut 18:11); C0637 itemizes Lev 19:31 as consulting mediums.

statement: Do not practise as a yidoni (familiar-spirit diviner)
note: C0638 itemizes Lev 19:31 as consulting enchanters; C1075 (Deut 18:11, yidoni rendered 'portents') bans the practice.

statement: Honour the aged and the wise (rise before them)
note: Only Mosaic Command records C0639 and C0640 itemize it; a standing conduct rule like Torah Law C0595 (revere parents).

statement: Do not cheat with measures, weights or scales
note: C0642 itemizes Lev 19:35.

statement: Keep accurate scales, weights and measures
note: C0643 itemizes Lev 19:36 with Deut 25:15.

statement: The court must execute by burning where prescribed
note: C0650 (Lev 20:14) and C0660 (Lev 21:9) apply the burning judgment.

statement: Do not follow the customs and statutes of the nations
note: Lev 20:23 itself has only study S094; AUD-03-18-3 (Lev 18:3, 'walk in their statutes') and C0241 itemize it.

statement: A priest must not defile himself for the dead, except relatives
note: C0654 itemizes Lev 21:1-4.

statement: A priest must defile himself for close relatives (mourning)
note: C0654 names the relatives only as exceptions (permission); the duty to mourn them is not stated.

statement: A priest who immersed may not serve before sunset
note: AUD-03-21-6 states general priestly holiness and notes no bathing-timing rule; C0670 bars unclean priests generally.

statement: A priest must not marry a prostitute (zonah)
note: C0656 itemizes this clause of Lev 21:7.

statement: A priest must not marry a profaned woman (chalalah)
note: C0657 itemizes this clause of Lev 21:7.

statement: A priest must not marry a divorced woman
note: C0658 itemizes this clause of Lev 21:7.

statement: Honour the priest and treat him as holy
note: C0659 addresses the community's duty to maintain the priest's consecrated status.

statement: The high priest must not enter a house with a corpse
note: C0663 itemizes Lev 21:11, which bars entering where a dead person is.

statement: The high priest must not defile himself for any dead, even parents
note: C0663 states the even-for-parents rule explicitly.

statement: A Nazirite must not enter a building containing a corpse
note: N208 is the Nazirite rule; C0816 (Num 6:6-7) itemizes it. Lev 21:11's high-priest record C0663 is only the analogy.

statement: The high priest must marry a virgin
note: C0666 itemizes Lev 21:13-14.

statement: The high priest must not marry a widow
note: C0667 itemizes the widow exclusion of Lev 21:14.

statement: The high priest must not cohabit with a widow, even unmarried
note: C0668 itemizes Lev 21:15 ('not profane his seed'), the clause Maimonides applies to non-marital relations.

statement: A priest with a permanent blemish must not serve
note: C0669 itemizes Lev 21:17-23.

statement: A priest with a temporary blemish must not serve
note: C0669 covers the listed blemishes without distinguishing temporary ones, which Maimonides counts separately.

statement: A blemished priest must not enter the sanctuary interior
note: C0669 includes not entering beyond the permitted boundary (Lev 21:23).

statement: An unclean priest must not perform sanctuary service
note: C0670 (Lev 22:3-7, with 22:2) bars unclean priests from approaching holy things.

statement: An unclean priest must not eat terumah (holy food)
note: C0670 bars unclean priests from eating holy things until cleansed.

statement: A non-priest must not eat terumah (holy food)
note: AUD-03-22-10 states only the lodger/hired clause; the general outsider ban is itemized only for the consecration meal (C0329).

statement: A priest's lodger or hired worker must not eat terumah
note: AUD-03-22-10 (Torah Law) itemizes this clause of Lev 22:10.

statement: An uncircumcised priest must not eat terumah
note: Derived from Lev 22:10; AUD-03-22-10 holds the verse but no record states the uncircumcised exclusion (C0111 is Passover).

statement: A profaned woman or priest's daughter wed to outsider: no terumah
note: AUD-03-22-12 itemizes the literal clause; Maimonides applies it to the profaned woman (chalalah).

statement: Do not eat untithed produce (tevel)
note: C0674 holds Lev 22:15 but states not profaning holy contributions; no record bans eating untithed produce.

statement: Do not consecrate a blemished animal for the altar
note: C0675 itemizes Lev 22:20-25.

statement: Offer only unblemished animals
note: C0675 states the rule negatively (no blemished animals); there is no separate positive record.

statement: Do not inflict a blemish on a consecrated animal
note: C0675 holds Lev 22:21 but bans offering blemished animals, not causing a blemish.

statement: Do not slaughter a blemished animal as an offering
note: C0675 covers offering blemished animals (Lev 22:22).

statement: Do not burn a blemished animal's parts on the altar
note: C0675's ban on offering blemished animals covers placing them on the altar (Lev 22:22).

statement: Do not sprinkle the blood of a blemished animal
note: C0675 and C0676 bar offering castrated or blemished animals (Lev 22:24); the blood rite is not singled out.

statement: Do not castrate any male, human or animal
note: C0676 itemizes the castration ban in the land; it names animals only.

statement: Do not offer blemished animals supplied by a foreigner
note: C0675 explicitly includes animals supplied by foreigners (Lev 22:25).

statement: Offer animals only from their eighth day onward
note: Lev 22:27 has no own record; only C0211 (Exod 22:29, Instruction) holds it, though offering-eligibility rules are Torah Law.

statement: Do not slaughter a mother and its young on one day
note: C0677 itemizes Lev 22:28.

statement: Do not leave thanksgiving-offering meat until morning
note: C0450 (Lev 7:15) holds Lev 22:30 as additional Scripture.

statement: Sanctify God's name publicly (kiddush Hashem)
note: C0591 holds Lev 22:32 but states only the ban on profaning; no record states sanctifying the name.

statement: Do not profane God's name
note: C0591 (Lev 18:21) holds Lev 22:32 as additional Scripture.

statement: Bring the omer (first sheaf) offering
note: Itemized by Instruction records C0682 and C1243; a festival rite procedure, so not a mislabel.

statement: Do not eat bread from new grain before the omer
note: C0684 covers all new grain before the offering.

statement: Do not eat roasted new grain before the omer
note: C0684 covers the roasted grain of Lev 23:14.

statement: Do not eat fresh new ears before the omer
note: Saints lists bread and roasted fresh grain; C0684 covers all new grain.
